d: Jonathan and Mark try to help a heartless used car salesman reconsider his actions on Christmas Eve.
Investigating a friend's death, Mark encounters drug smugglers; guests Michael Bowen, Lee Bryant.
Jonathan attempts to fan the flames of love between a woman and her ex-husband's best friend.
Mark is in a state between life and death when he's critically injured in a car accident.
Jonathan steps in when a heart condition sidelines a promising basketball player's dreams.
A dying woman tries to reconcile with her stern father for the sake of her illegitimate daughter.
Mark and Jonathan's quadriplegic friend falls in love with Mark's cousin.
Jonathan arranges an exchange between a pitiless millionaire and a kind vagrant.
Jonathan and Mark meet a child star whose fame is spoiling her rotten and destroying her family.
Jonathan encourages residents in a neighborhood to unite against a cold-hearted developer.

Mark helps longtime friends cope when their adopted daughter wants to find her natural parents.
Jonathan and Mark connect a young blind woman with a disfigured artist.
Jonathan and Mark's friend Scotty is on hand to provide legal assistance.
Jonathan and Mark discover that the star player's injury has resulted in drug dependency.

A reporter uncovers a secret about the past of a woman who runs a home for unwed mothers.

A man whose son died in Vietnam learns that he has an Amerasian grandson.

st: Another Kind of War, Another Kind of Peace
d: A man whose son died in Vietnam learns that he has an Amerasian grandson.

Bickering couples go on a trip to learn what it was that brought them together.

Mark plans to give a recent windfall to a boys' club. But first he must deal with some con artists.
Jonathan and Mark help a cynical newspaper columnist find the Christmas spirit.

A struggling pianist tries to start life again after a heart attack.

Jonathan and Mark visit a halfway house for people who were once confined to mental hospitals.

Jonathan and Mark help a black family relocate to an exclusive neighborhood.
